How We Create True Abundance (Through Solarpunk, Ecosocialism, and Degrowth)

Our Changing Climate
Jul 31 2026 • 24 mins
This podcast is best in video form! You can watch this one and 200+ more on the Our Changing Climate YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@OurChangingClimate
In this Our Changing Climate climate change podcast, I explore how solarpunk, ecosocialism, and degrowth are the path towards true abundance. Specifically, I examine how Ezra Klein and Derek Thompson's politics of Abundance is mired in neoliberal, reformist, and austerity politics that won't ultimately bring the solarpunk-esque world that they envision in the first chapter of their book. We need to looking towards the visions of solarpunk for inspiration and steep ourselves in the political and economic strategies of ecosocialism and degrowth to find a path towards true abundance.
